verdict.rationale: Paddle clearly documents fast checkout options: an overlay checkout needing minimal frontend code, a Paddle.js checkout, a sandbox, and a Next.js starter kit with integrated checkout. A solo founder also reports using Paddle to take payments. However, nothing in the pack shows how long it takes from signup to accepting live payments, or covers any account approval or verification step. Missing for 10: evidence of signup-to-live timing and onboarding/approval requirements, explicit card-payment coverage, and independent hands-on corroboration of a same-day launch.
